description: Compose and render background music locally as a seamless stereo WAV loop (the WAV carries a loop point; one full piece with intro, themes and outro, about 1-2 minutes). Every seed is a different piece in the same style. Moods: calm (Calm Eastern piece: guqin and bamboo flute over strings. Exploration, villages, menus.); battle (Eastern battle music: pipa, spiccato low strings and big war drums. Combat, bosses.); mystery (Sparse, misty Eastern piece: flute and guqin over held strings, wooden fish. Caves, ruins, night.); sad (Slow erhu lament over strings and guqin. Loss, farewells, sad story beats.); primitive (Stone age: bone flute over a hummed drone, log drums, clapping sticks and a shaker. Cavemen, tribal camps, prehistory.); tribal (Early village: clay ocarina (xun) and bamboo flute, plucked zither, frame and log drums, low hum. Farming villages, early civilisation.); medieval (Medieval folk tune in dorian: fiddle and shawm, lute, bagpipe drone, frame drum and tambourine. Towns, taverns, markets, castles.). Also renders short stingers instead when "stinger" is given: victory (Bright drum hit, pipa run and bell. Win, quest complete.); defeat (Falling guqin, low bell and erhu. Loss, game over.); battleStart (Three war drum hits and a gong. A fight begins.); treasure (Rising chimes and a bell. Treasure, rare item.); breakthrough (Low bell, rising guqin and flute. Level up, realm breakthrough.); guiltCannibal (About 2 s, quiet: an erhu note sags down over a low hum. A dark deed (eating your own kind).); guiltChild (About 2 s, quiet: two ocarina notes a semitone apart. A terrible deed (harming a child).); grief (About 2.5 s, quiet: a low hum with two guqin notes. Someone close has died.).

out_path.description: WAV file to write, e.g. "assets/music/town.wav". With count > 1, files get -01, -02 ... suffixes.

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible piece; piece i uses seed + i

stinger.description: Render this short stinger instead of a loop

name: generate_music
title: Compose a music loop
